item.title: In 2020, Albany brought 1,500 feet of Patroon Creek back above ground after decades in a pipe
item.description: Engineers in Albany revitalized Patroon Creek by daylighting it, restoring its natural flow and creating vital green spaces. This innovative project significantly bolstered flood protection for surrounding neighborhoods. Post-restoration water monitoring assured that the creek effectively managed heavy rains, tackling water quality concerns while promoting a healthier aquatic ecosystem. The initiative not only enhances the environment but also provides recreational opportunities for the local community. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: In 2021, Pennsylvania removed a 128-year-old dam; Sterry Creek’s original channel was still intact
item.description: The Nature Conservancy has successfully revitalized the O'Conner Reservoir dam from the late 1800s, allowing Sterry Creek to revert to its natural course. By lowering the reservoir's water levels and excavating the embankment, they eliminated the need for a costly artificial channel, thus improving local water health. This project also established a natural floodplain and reconnected important stream habitats to the expansive Lackawanna River watershed. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Medicine, food and other supplies are the urgent priority. But the rising risks from shrinking glaciers must be faced too Thousands of people in Nepal and Tibet are in desperate need of emergency assistance following Wednesday’s disaster. With 360 people confirmed dead, more than 1,300 others are still missing as search and rescue operations continue. The precise sequence of events linking glacier collapse to flash floods is yet to be confirmed. But there is no doubting the enormous destructive power of the brown torrent that can be seen on video clips surging down the steeply sided Himalayan… Fuente: The Guardian - Environment.

item.description: Soaring prices are plunging struggling families into debt. The government must support them in the short term as it invests in a clean energy future Fuelled by the consequences of Donald Trump’s disastrous war on Iran, household energy debt in Britain is continuing to soar, rising to a record £6bn by the end of June. That figure is set to hit £7bn by the end of the year, as the government’s cap on gas and electricity prices goes up to a three-year high in October. The human cost among the less well off will be more people regularly choosing whether to skip meals, ignore other bills or stay… Fuente: The Guardian - Environment.

item.title: How rising air plumes help spike moist heat
item.description: As climate change has led to more frequent extreme-heat events around the world, moist heat metrics such as wet-bulb temperature, which combines temperature and humidity, have become increasingly relevant. Days with both high heat and high humidity are dangerous to human health; understanding how these extreme events will change in the future is important. Fuente: Phys.org.

Desde la Cámara Salvadoreña de Pequeños y Medianos Productores Agropecuarios advierten que la cosecha de agosto y septiembre podría sufrir pérdidas importantes. item.title: MIT built AI system to map extreme events that have never happened before
item.description: MIT engineers have developed an AI-based machine-learning method that can create realistic scenarios for extreme weather events that have never been recorded. The system can generate maps showing the possible size, intensity and duration of rare storms. Using weather statistics and spatial data, it can model events that are more extreme than those in the training data. Researchers say the method could help planners prepare for extreme rainfall, floods and wildfires. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
